## Summary

Pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation approved by the Hon’ble National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Division Bench, Chennai, Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. is amalgamating into Dr. Agarwals Health Care Limited. The record date has been fixed as November 18, 2026, and trading in the equity shares of Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. (Scrip Code: 526783) will be suspended effective November 18, 2026.

## Key Points

- **Amalgamation**: Merger of Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. (Transferor Company) into Dr. Agarwals Health Care Limited (Transferee Company).
- **Record Date**: November 18, 2026.
- **Suspension / No Dealings**: Effective November 18, 2026 (Notice No. DR-759/2026-2027).
- **Share Swap Ratio**: 23 fully paid-up equity shares of Re. 1/- each of Dr. Agarwals Health Care Limited for every 2 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 10/- each held in Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Limited.

## Regulatory Changes

- Approval of the Scheme of Amalgamation by the Hon’ble NCLT, Division Bench, Chennai.

## Compliance Requirements

- Trading members are requested not to deal in the equity shares of Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. w.e.f. November 18, 2026.

## Important Dates

- **Record Date**: November 18, 2026
- **Suspension Effective Date**: November 18, 2026

## Impact Assessment

- Shareholders of Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. are entitled to receive equity shares of Dr. Agarwals Health Care Limited as per the specified share swap ratio upon the scheme coming into effect. Trading in equity shares of Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital Ltd. stands suspended.
